billed_reconciliation.read_by: Andrew, Anthropic console usage by model, 2026-11-26 21:46 EST
billed_reconciliation.assumption: all Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 5.5 usage on this key in the window is this extraction run (15 filings: UAA 5, USB 5, VFC 5, plus one redone lean probe call)

seconds_basis: sum of wallclock over a filing's logged (successful) extract calls; calls that failed outright wrote no line and are not counted
cost_basis: sum of cost_usd logged by the claude CLI on successful calls, at list price; failed attempts and CLI helper calls are not logged
